publisher: Leenstra & Parthesius 2022, Dutch Ships in Asian Waters in the 17th Century
intended_question: Does the archived cargo database name plant commodities and permit keys to the actual 1595–1698 inter-island port legs, without assuming cargo was a butterfly larval host?
evidence_rules: Source checksums and table grain verified before any cargo claim

Taxonomic similarity to HOSTS requires a species-level scientific-name crosswalk, not vernacular group names
